decisions.subject: The CHAT-156 order of authority applies per lot figure: each field takes its own highest-ranked held figure
decisions.recommendation: Per figure (the built default): frontage, depth, area and corner each take the highest-ranked figure held for that field, not one document for the whole lot. Totals are identical to the lot-level reading; the approved CHAT-156 evidence (A0203/26EYK restored) holds only per figure.

decisions.subject: The scorer's lot disclosure lists the non-survey plan figures read; parcel use is recorded as lot_source 'parcel' and is not disclosed
decisions.recommendation: Keep the built default: lot_disclosure names each non-survey plan figure read; parcel use shows on every row as lot_source 'parcel'; a row with no parcel shows no figure.

decisions.subject: The curved-front caution of M-313 applies to every ranked frontage source, not only a survey
decisions.recommendation: Keep the built default: the straight-line frontage rule (800.50(445) / CHAT-46) is applied to every ranked frontage source, so a frontage printed on any document for a curved-front lot is not read (A0247/26NY stays unread and MATCH); M-308's known limit stays.

decisions.subject: A site-plan lot figure is one of the figures the City examined, ranked after plan statistics and before the decision notice
decisions.recommendation: Option B: the scorer's order becomes survey, zoning notice, plan statistics, site plan, decision notice, then parcel. Amends CHAT-156's four-source order; the CHAT-148 re-pin is taken at this reading (expected 172 93.03 %, A0375/26TEY#1 DIFFER -> DATA; the scorer lane re-measures). Floors unchanged (M-322). Scorer only: the calculator never reads plan facts (M-333). Evidence: the operator's golden-case keying confirmed A0375/26TEY frontage 6.1 m and depth 39.01 m.

decisions.subject: Plan-facts figures with an unknown source are re-read against their documents in a later pre-registered round

decisions.subject: Held but unread plan-facts figures are shown on the row as a values-only disclosure field; they are read only after the CHAT-164 round
decisions.recommendation: Show now: each row names the plan-facts figure held but not read and why (unknown source, curved front); no class or value moves. Reading them waits for the CHAT-164 round.
